'''PMX4 polarized proximity bombs''' were a type of explosive weapons. Such bombs were used by the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Watchdog]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=operation|R-4 Anomaly}}</ref>
